evidence.quote: Suggest title change to be more specific ie, include “the International Society for Medical Publication Professionals experience”.

Thank you for this suggestion.  We would prefer to keep the title concise and avoid the risk of readers inferring the article came from International Society for Medical Publication Professionals (ISMPP).  We have, however, included more specific details about ISMPP in the introduction and the abstract specifies that the data came from the ISMPP Annual Meetings.
